chunks: Alas the woe that day for those who deny!
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the fate of those who deny the truth on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Mursalat (77:24) underscores the inevitability of divine retribution for those who persistently deny the Prophets and Imams, linking their denial to the broader theme of 'Wail' (woe) mentioned in the preceding verses. It serves as a warning that rejection of truth is not merely an intellectual stance but a spiritual condition leading to eternal suffering, a concept reinforced by the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings on the consequences of Kufr.
